test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 04 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What amount has been allocated to the Khelo India Programme in the FY 2025-26 Budget?
solution:
The correct answer is __**₹1,000 crore**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Khelo India Programme** is a flagship initiative of the Government of India under the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports aimed at promoting sports and physical fitness across the nation.
 
• In the **FY 2025-26 Budget**, an allocation of **₹1,000 crore** has been earmarked for the programme to enhance infrastructure, training facilities, and support for athletes at grassroots and elite levels.
 
• The programme emphasizes creating a strong sports culture in India by identifying and nurturing young talent through initiatives like **Khelo India Youth Games** and **Khelo India University Games**.
 
• It also aims to strengthen the school and college sports ecosystem by providing financial assistance for sports infrastructure development and training programs.
 
• **₹1,000 crore** is a significant increase in funding compared to previous years, demonstrating the government's commitment to fostering sports excellence and promoting physical fitness among citizens.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Khelo India Programme Overview:**

 
 
• The programme was launched in **2018** with the objective of creating a sports culture and infrastructure across India.
 
• It includes various components such as **Talent Identification and Development, Sports Infrastructure Development, Fitness Assessment, and Promotion of Indigenous Games**.
 
• Under this initiative, athletes are provided scholarships worth **₹5 lakh per annum** for eight years to support their training and participation in national and international events.
 
 
 
• **Khelo India Youth Games (KIYG):**
 
 
• The **Khelo India Youth Games** is an annual multi-disciplinary grassroots sports event launched to encourage young talent.
 
• It features participation from schools and colleges across India in multiple sports disciplines.
 
• The event plays a crucial role in identifying and nurturing future sports stars.
 
 
 
• **Sports Infrastructure Development:**
 
 
• Under the Khelo India Programme, the government has invested in developing sports facilities such as stadiums, training centers, and fitness hubs across rural and urban areas.
 
• Special focus is given to regions with limited access to sports infrastructure.
 
 
 
• **National Fitness Campaign:**
 
 
• The programme includes initiatives to promote physical fitness among citizens through fitness assessments and awareness campaigns.
 
• Schools and colleges are encouraged to integrate fitness activities into their curriculum.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Key Achievements:**

 
 
• The programme has successfully identified and nurtured several athletes who have represented India at international events like the **Olympics, Asian Games, and Commonwealth Games**.
 
• It has contributed to the rise in India's medal tally in international competitions by providing world-class training and facilities.
 
 
 
• **Future Plans:**
 
 
• The increased allocation of **₹1,000 crore** will be used to expand the programme's reach to more schools, colleges, and rural areas.
 
• The government plans to introduce advanced technology and analytics to monitor athlete performance and improve training methodologies.
 
 
 
• **Support for Indigenous Games:**
 
 
• The programme includes the promotion of **traditional and indigenous sports** like Kabaddi, Kho-Kho, and Mallakhamb to preserve India's rich sporting heritage.
 
• Dedicated funds are allocated for the development of facilities and training programs for such games.
